name: 06470 · Newtown, CT
findings: ZIP 06470 (Newtown) has 101 nonprofit organizations. 48 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06470 (Newtown) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 06470 (Newtown) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.4 times the typical level).
